title: 第15章 给两位富哥多准备些太岁土第16章 采蘑菇怕躺板板去灵药峰问问
slug: 厨神把师姐们喂成女帝
content_zh:
围观的众人觉得自己彻底坏掉了。
还要林东方提意见？
改进？
这位南域第一剑莫非想改行当个锻打菜刀的铁匠？
任健和周长青已经陷入痴呆状态。
林东方接过那颇为沉重的菜刀，顿时爱不释手。
锋利程度不用多说。
林东方有种感觉，等到他修为足够，这一把刀甚至能砍断世间万物！
刀身弧度妙到毫巅，只是挥舞几下，他就知道这把刀比原来用过的任何一把刀都要省力。
这菜刀坚硬无比，别说拍大蒜，就算是拍通天境大妖的脑壳都像是拍鸡蛋壳一样容易。
林东方取出一个土豆，刚想切点土豆丝试试自己这把宝刀，但一想到自己厨仙体的秘密就把土豆收了起来。
这地方什么人都有。
端详着这漂亮的菜刀，心里开始盘算。
‘独孤师叔既然连夜打菜刀送我，想来也是知道了我的体质…’
‘圣主他们还是记挂我的…’
‘灵儿说她脑海里出现了有关我厨仙体秘密的禁制，想来沈师兄脑海里也有…’
想到那天圣主吃完火锅说的话，他心里明白过来。
‘等会要是和沈师兄说起的话应该没什么问题。
太岁土这东西他不好亲自出面往外卖。
火灵儿和萧曦月也不合适。

再一看眼前的沈浪。
这哥们一看就是个机灵人！
“沈师兄，不如来我的小院坐坐？正好给你做点好菜吃吃。”
“哎呀，这怎么好意思…哈哈！”
嘴上说着客气，身体倒是很诚实！
沈浪直接和林东方勾肩搭背。
独孤浩说了，要认真对待林东方说的每一句话。
他自然要好好遵从恩师的教诲。
先去吃一顿！
“咳咳，林师弟刚刚说还需要一把杀猪刀？”
沈浪清清嗓子，扯开话题。
林东方点点头，“以后出门历练的时候总不能用菜刀杀人，还是用杀猪刀比较好，免得弄脏了菜刀。”
众人眩晕，原来不用菜刀杀人是怕弄脏菜刀。
还真他娘的是个好厨子！
沈浪点点头，掏出本子记上了。
content_en:
The onlookers felt that they were completely broken.
Do you want Lin Dongfang to give advice?
improve?
Could it be that the number one swordsman in the Southern Territory wants to change his career to become a blacksmith who forges kitchen knives?
Ren Jian and Zhou Changqing have fallen into a state of dementia.
Lin Dongfang took the heavy kitchen knife and couldn't put it down immediately.
Needless to say the sharpness.
Lin Dongfang has a feeling that when he reaches enough cultivation level, this knife can even cut through everything in the world!
The arc of the blade was astonishing. After just a few swings, he knew that this knife was more energy-saving than any other knife he had ever used before.
This kitchen knife is extremely hard. Not to mention hitting garlic, even hitting the head of a Tongtian Realm demon is as easy as hitting an egg shell.
Lin Dongfang took out a potato. He was about to cut some shredded potatoes and try his precious knife, but when he thought of the secret of his cooking immortal body, he put the potato away.
There is everyone in this place.
Looking at this beautiful kitchen knife, I started to think about it.
'Since Uncle Dugu spent the whole night preparing kitchen knives for me, I guess he knows my physique...'
'Holy Lord, they still care about me...'
'Ling'er said that there were restrictions on the secret of my Kitchen Immortal Body in her mind, and I think Senior Brother Shen also had them in his mind...'
Thinking of what the Holy Master said that day after eating hot pot, he understood in his heart.
‘If I talk to Senior Brother Shen later, there should be no problem.
It's hard for him to sell Tai Sui soil in person.
Huo Ling'er and Xiao Xiyue are also not suitable.
Look at Shen Lang in front of you again.
This guy is a smart guy at first glance!
"Senior Brother Shen, why don't you come and sit in my courtyard? I'll make you some delicious food."
"Oh, how can this be so embarrassing...haha!"
He says he is polite, but his body is very honest!
Shen Lang directly hooked up with Lin Dongfang.
Duguhao said that he should take every word Lin Dongfang said seriously.
Naturally, he must follow his mentor's teachings.
Go have a meal first!
"Ahem, Junior Brother Lin just said that he still needs a butcher knife?"
Shen Lang cleared his throat and changed the subject.
Lin Dongfang nodded, "You can't kill people with a kitchen knife when you go out for training in the future. It's better to use a butcher's knife to avoid getting the kitchen knife dirty."
Everyone was stunned. It turned out that they didn't use kitchen knives to kill people because they were afraid of getting the kitchen knives dirty.
What a damn good cook!
Shen Lang nodded, took out his notebook and wrote it down.
